patch.scope: Isolated same-shape wide F32 row copy experiment. Width 0 keeps the existing dispatch; widths 1,4,8 explicitly opt in. Strided rows preserve all source and destination strides. Unaligned vectors and different shapes fall back. No model, cache, rollback or launcher default changes. Separate conv-direct mode skips an intermediate contiguous tensor before the existing strided copy; all rollback slots remain.

patch.scope: Private opt-in M5Pro compact expert/token tile dispatch after original route map. Q2_0 gate/up [2560,640,512] and down [640,2560,512], F32 contiguous activations/output, I32 top10 IDs, T32..512, DEFAULT/F32 source precision and exact stock MM eligibility. GPU prefix worklist uses own appended allocation after unchanged amax, bounded static dispatch, same matrix arithmetic with function-constant expert/tile remap. Allocation, overlap, alignment and layout guards fall back; invalid GPU count or capacity fails closed. Private encoding counter and once-only encoded marker. No route-map reuse, graph reorder, model/cache/precision/default changes. V2 changes only compact grid axes to place output-channel tiles first, their logical coordinate remap, and matching overflow output indexing. Worklist construction, capacity, scratch, barriers, matrix arithmetic and fallback grid are identical to V1.
